           SELECT CUSTOMER-ERROR ASSIGN TO "customers.error"
               ORGANIZATION IS LINE SEQUENTIAL.

WRITE-ERROR-CUSTOMER.

           WRITE CUSTOMER-ERROR-RECORD
           ADD 1 TO WS-ERROR-COUNT.

       FD  ACCOUNT-IN.
       01  ACCOUNT-INPUT-RECORD.
           05 AR-ACCOUNT-ID         PIC 9(8).
           05 AR-BALANCE            PIC S9(9)V99.
           05 AR-STATUS             PIC X.
       FD  REPORT-OUT.
       01  REPORT-OUTPUT-RECORD      PIC X(80).

OPEN-FILES.
           OPEN INPUT CUSTOMER-IN
                OUTPUT CUSTOMER-OUT CUSTOMER-ERROR.

HANDLE-POST-RESULT.

               WHEN "00" CONTINUE
               WHEN "04" DISPLAY "ACCOUNT ON HOLD: "
                                  WS-ACCOUNT-ID(WS-INDEX)
               WHEN OTHER DISPLAY "TRANSACTION REJECTED: "
                                  WS-ACCOUNT-ID(WS-INDEX)
           END-EVALUATE.
